rollout.tool: actual scene_classify, registered tool calls only, role-separated feedback
rollout.state: same last valid decoding-step final-layer final-position hidden tensor is cached and passed to frozen scorer; no terminal forward-state replacement
rollout.quality: nonempty completed answer, no generated result tags, no mixed/unknown tool calls, no addCriterion, no token-limit or round-limit; failures retained
rollout.format_reward: 0.2 exactly when new rollout quality passes, otherwise 0.0; stricter than historical regex-only bonus
rollout.sampling_distribution: untruncated categorical softmax; first-token EOS suppression from min_new_tokens=1 is identically applied in policy logprob
rollout.tool_boundary_stop: complete scene_classify closing tag only; answers end on native configured EOS

pilot.gate: at least95% strict completed answers with a model-requested tool and consumed recorded real feedback; generated-result failure at most2%
pilot.selection: first passing prompt by fixed priority, only train63 protocol outcomes used; no utility/val based selection

baseline: same legacy harbor prompt;273 exact state replays plus2 training warm anchors, each saves complete final-layer decode-step matrices

fallback_training.trigger: no prompt candidate passes train63 gate
fallback_training.loss: existing SFT format-token loss, answer body/user/tool feedback excluded; normalize all6 assistant targets by active-format-token count
fallback_training.selection: fixed final30; repeat same train63 gates only

state_contract.last: unchanged last actual generate final-layer final-position state
state_contract.answer_prefill: first generate-step state of final strict answer round after requested tool feedback; last prompt token representation
state_contract.answer_pool: mean of actual generate states whose INPUT token lies wholly within answer body; byte-level actual-token alignment, step index=generated token index+1; float64 CPU mean cast BF16
state_contract.undefined: retain case; fall back to same-trajectory last state with reason and explicit coverage; no case filtering
state_contract.raw_evidence: save every final-layer actual generation-step state, emitted IDs, input IDs and body-byte spans

evaluation.compact_storage: text features once per readout, prior banks once per family/split; each forward saves image features, scores and top-k plus source indices

analysis.contrasts: correct minus20permmean; correct minusshared within6families; prefill/pool minuslast within each prompt; selected_last minuslegacy_last
